Key strategic considerations:
1. My personal preference order is: z > w > y > x
2. My priority rank at schools is: w: 1, x: 2, y: 1, z: 2

By observing that most applicants seem to prefer y > x > w > z, I recognize that this might create competition at schools y and x.

Given my high priority status at w and y (both rank 1), these schools are most likely in my "obtainable set". Between these, z is my absolute top preference. So I want to strategically rank z first to ensure I get my most preferred school if possible.

By ranking z first, I signal my strong preference for z while maintaining realistic expectations based on my priority ranks.
